title: Asset crop workflow
description: One original artwork branches into square and portrait crops, with each connection leading to a downloadable result.
useCase: Explain an asset transformation through directed connections and concrete outputs that retain the source image's identity.
interaction: Create crops, cancel or replay, then download either SVG
reducedMotion: Both crops appear immediately. The native action and SVG downloads stay available.
limitations: Two centered viewBox crops of an original SVG artwork. The short reveal sequence explains their relationship; it does not represent network or rendering progress. No image upload, raster conversion or external service.
look: Light lilac-grey workspace with white rounded cards: a magenta-and-plum flower artwork on the left joined by thin purple elbow connectors to square and portrait crops.
motion: A button starts a 1.12 s sequence: connector strokes draw toward each output, dashed crop guides appear on the artwork, then each crop fades up and scales in (cubic ease-out).
adapt: One rAF clock advances `progress` over `DURATION` (1120 ms); `segment` maps it to the `trunk` and `branch` stroke offsets and to each crop's `start`/`end` window, eased by `easeOut`. Replace `Artwork` and the `crops` viewBoxes with your asset and outputs.
